notes: Open Valley is the publisher. HUUSD is the school district; entity_id huusd is the district observation unit. District directory source huusd-schools and community/structure source huusd-about identify Duxbury, Fayston, Moretown, Waitsfield, Warren and Waterbury.
Seven directory schools/campuses have eight K–12 reporting groups because Harwood middle/high share one school identity and campus. Never add a combined Harwood total to its components.

Current facts describe 2026–27 as checked October 4, 2026, not the dates on which configurations took effect. Historical observations carry their own grade scopes and source definitions. PK is separate; historical Fayston/Waitsfield PK must not be inferred from the current three-hub configuration.

current_enrollment_ref points to the September 2026 preliminary snapshot, whose exact count day and Early College treatment are unverified. latest_attending_enrollment_ref points to October 1, 2025. Both dates/statuses must remain visible; these are different series, not two interchangeable current totals.

Undated website marketing enrollment figures were not used. All annual observed counts are marked observed because final certification was not established; observed must not be displayed as certified final.

Pathways describe the usual structure, not guaranteed individual assignment. K–8 applications are subject to capacity and procedures. No attendance zones, nearest-school assignments or transportation guarantees are inferred.

Campus points use the state layer's returned geometry rounded to five decimals. They are general-reference locations, not surveyed entrances. Warren's older address discrepancy was resolved with the E911 source without moving its marker.
These are reviewed candidate inputs. Catalog additions, host validation and the publication lifecycle are required before runtime use. No app or database release is implied by this file.
